#include <iostream>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

// Global tokenizer state
istringstream tokenizer;
string currentLine;

string next() {
    string token;
    while (!(tokenizer >> token)) {
        getline(cin, currentLine);
        if (cin.eof()) break;
        tokenizer.clear();
        tokenizer.str(currentLine);
    }
    return token;
}

int nextInt() {
    return stoi(next());
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n = nextInt();
    string s = next();

    vector<vector<int>> a(3, vector<int>(n));
    vector<int> na(3, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        char ch = s[i];
        if (ch == 'V') {
            a[0][na[0]++] = i;
        } else if (ch == 'K') {
            a[1][na[1]++] = i;
        } else {
            a[2][na[2]++] = i;
        }
    }

    // Initialize DP table
    vector<vector<vector<vector<int>>>> d(
        na[0] + 1,
        vector<vector<vector<int>>>(
            na[1] + 1,
            vector<vector<int>>(
                na[2] + 1,
                vector<int>(2, INT_MAX)
            )
        )
    );

    // Precompute inversions
    vector<vector<vector<int>>> p(3, vector<vector<int>>(3, vector<int>(n, 0)));
    for (int x = 0; x < 3; ++x) {
        for (int y = 0; y < 3; ++y) {
            if (x != y) {
                for (int i = 0; i < na[x]; ++i) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < na[y]; ++j) {
                        if (a[y][j] < a[x][i]) {
                            p[x][y][i]++;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    d[0][0][0][1] = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= na[0]; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= na[1]; ++j) {
            for (int k = 0; k <= na[2]; ++k) {
                for (int q = 0; q < 2; ++q) {
                    int val = d[i][j][k][q];
                    if (val == INT_MAX) continue;
                    if (i < na[0]) {
                        int cost = val + max(p[0][1][i] - j, 0) + max(p[0][2][i] - k, 0);
                        d[i+1][j][k][0] = min(d[i+1][j][k][0], cost);
                    }
                    if (j < na[1] && q == 1) {
                        int cost = val + max(p[1][0][j] - i, 0) + max(p[1][2][j] - k, 0);
                        d[i][j+1][k][1] = min(d[i][j+1][k][1], cost);
                    }
                    if (k < na[2]) {
                        int cost = val + max(p[2][0][k] - i, 0) + max(p[2][1][k] - j, 0);
                        d[i][j][k+1][1] = min(d[i][j][k+1][1], cost);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    int ans = min(d[na[0]][na[1]][na[2]][0], d[na[0]][na[1]][na[2]][1]);
    cout << ans << endl;

    return 0;
}
